name: models
note: The frozen oracle GLBs that CanonData v1 depends on (03 sections 3.1, 3.3, 4.7, 4.8): buildings.glb (pane names and order index the lit flags of placements.json) and trees.glb (species meshes and LODs). Byte copies of the oracle blobs, read with git -c core.autocrlf=false archive; v1 itself never changes (PLAN 1.2 refs). The Unity importer verifies these hashes like the v1 manifest.
